english.title: False statement in application to United Kingdom operator of aircraft for identity pass
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), for the purpose of or in connection with an application made by

(a)_[you]_
(b)_[another]_

for the issue of an identity document to which section 21B(1) of the Aviation Security Act 1982 applied, made to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) an employee or agent of the operator of one or more aircraft registered or operating in the United Kingdom, a statement which you knew to be false in a material particular or recklessly made to the said **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) a statement which was false in a material particular in that **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 21B(1)(a) and (5) of the Aviation Security Act 1982.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
